storyText: A message without a subject is refused with 422 and `{"subject": ["The subject field is required."]}`
faults.seen: a message without a subject is refused with "The selected subject is invalid." instead of "The subject field is required."

storyText: From then on the message shows the new status
one of NEW, IN_PROGRESS or RESOLVED, and gets `{"success": true}`
faults.seen: setting RESOLVED answers {"success": true} but the message then shows IN_PROGRESS (admin detail after reload, customer's My messages, GET /messages/{id})

storyText: Without signing in the list is refused with 401 and "Unauthorized"
faults.seen: GET /messages without a token answers 200 with an empty page instead of 401

storyText: A message may be up to 255 characters
A message text of 250 characters is accepted; a longer one is refused
traps.expected: raised as a question for the owner (250 or 255); a refusal of 251-255 characters is not reported as a defect
